dedupe_keys.name: solid waste management stakeholders database south sudan

description: Polish Humanitarian Action deposits a Bio4HUMAN stakeholder database for solid-waste management in South Sudan. Zenodo lists one public Excel workbook under CC BY 4.0. The description says it contains an executive summary, an inventory, definitions and separate sheets for industry, humanitarian organisations, government and policy actors, communities and academia. A modeller could use the actor inventory to define responsibilities or plausible coordination links in an agent-based waste-service or emergency-response simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this South Sudan stakeholder map. A limitation is that the landing page does not state the number of organisations, their service areas, a collection period, or whether listed relationships were observed. It does not supply waste quantities, routes, facility capacities or collection frequencies. Those operational inputs would need another source. The workbook was not downloaded, so row-level quality and contact details were not checked.
